new_locus_entity.canonical_name: Shadaw Township — Daw Taku testimony context

geometry.resolution_method: Use the modern Shadaw Township reference coordinate as navigation/testimony context because the ILO source fixes the witness to Daw Taku within Shadaw Township but exact Daw Taku geometry is not independently frozen. new_context_source.title: Forced labour in Myanmar (Burma) — Commission of Inquiry, Appendix VII, witness 101

new_locus_entity.notes: Bounded modern navigation identity for HRW's Lahore-outskirts brick-kiln evidence. It is not an exact kiln location and not Pakistan-wide practice extent.

geometry.resolution_method: Use the modern Lahore city point only as a navigation proxy for HRW's explicitly described brick-kilns on the outskirts of Lahore. Exact kiln coordinates are not supplied by the report.

new_context_source.title: Contemporary Forms of Slavery in Pakistan

new_context_source.claim_fitness: Independent bounded corroboration for brick-kiln debt bondage near Lahore; not a national prevalence measure.

locus_link.role_text: HRW Lahore-outskirts brick-kiln evidence context; modern Lahore point only

candidates.target: Brazil — rural debt bondage / forced labour, 2003–2005
candidates.rationale: The accepted ILO article repeatedly says 'Correntes' in Piauí, while IBGE's official municipality register identifies Corrente (PI), code 2202901. Brazilian Chamber material both lists Corrente as a recruitment municipality and elsewhere repeats 'município de Correntes'. The likely singular/plural identity relation is not sufficiently frozen to assign a coordinate without silently normalizing the source-native name.

identity_evidence.source: ILO — Waiting in Correntes: Forced labour in Brazil
identity_evidence.finding: source-native place label is Correntes, Piauí

candidates.reopen_condition: authoritative project/source record explicitly binds the ILO article's Correntes label to municipality Corrente (PI), or a distinct Correntes locality is independently identified
candidates.forbidden_shortcut: do not use Corrente coordinates merely because it is the closest plausible official municipality

candidates.rationale: The current packet already includes GBI camp 75/76 Schöneweide as bounded site-level corroboration. new_locus_entity.notes: Preserved Nazi forced-labour camp / current documentation-centre site. Evidence locus for one bounded part of the broader state forced-labour system.

geometry.resolution_method: Use the official Berlin monument Geoportal marker for Fremdarbeiterlager Niederschöneweide I. The monument record fixes the historic site and 1943–1945 dating. The official map link encodes ETRS89/UTM33N marker E 399469.30568613, N 5812435.43555859; transformed to WGS84 for the Atlas point.

geometry_source.title: Fremdarbeiterlager Niederschöneweide I — monument object 09045213
geometry_source.license_status: official public register; redistribution status not assumed

existing_evidence_source.note: The current claim packet already contains the Nazi Forced Labour Documentation Centre's history of GBI camp 75/76 Schöneweide as bounded site-level corroboration; do not duplicate that evidence source merely to create geometry.

locus_link.role_text: preserved GBI camp 75/76 Schöneweide forced-labour site; bounded evidence locus
